about: Fifteen Days pre-production, step 1 (owner's review, 2026-10-16): Bai and Deluin redrawn, the hall rebuilt after the tutorial, the courtyard with robot C and a wider table, the gate with the cafe's skyline, the lobby in B's mood. Text DRAFTED by the coding agent.

jobs.prompt: Face reference sheet on a plain flat mid-grey background with no scenery: six heads of the same person in two rows of three, all the same size, framed from the top of the head to the collarbone, even soft lighting. Top row, neutral expression: facing the viewer, a three-quarter view turned to the left, and a side profile facing left. Bottom row, all facing the viewer: a smile, an annoyed frown, surprise. Every head is clearly the same person with the same hair. Only a plain dark crew-neck collar shows at the neck, no costume. The person: a young woman of about eighteen, thin and wiry, of mixed Black and East Asian heritage: deep warm brown skin, narrow dark eyes with monolids, high cheekbones, a sharp jaw, a sly self-assured look; an extreme edgy haircut: both sides of her head shaved close, the top gathered into a tall high ponytail dyed hot magenta; a fine black geometric line tattoo running up the side of her neck (abstract shapes only, no letters). Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color, clear readable faces. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos anywhere.

Extreme wide establishing shot from the standing overlook at the very top of a vast round game hall inside a mountain, framed below the ceiling so no rock ceiling shows. Below the overlook's railing: a second tier of seats, then tiers of good seats close to the floor, all packed with a varied crowd of many ages, builds and skin tones in clothes of many colours. Over the open floor, large glowing three-dimensional holograms of the game in exactly the style of reference images 2 and 3, in only two colours, cyan and amber: black pillar towers topped with glowing cube clusters, some of them physical towers riding small robotic bases, rings of light on the floor, streams of small glowing gliders and little ships, walls of glowing cubes building. Hanging above the floor, two big screens, each showing one player's face in close-up. Far apart at opposite edges of the floor, two small sunken pits, each with one player at a glowing console, facing outward toward the wall, unable to see the holograms or each other. Use reference image 1 only for the hall's dark mood and shape.
